summary.value: TownePlace Suites by Marriott New York Manhattan/Chelsea is an extended-stay hotel at 140 West 28th Street, New York, NY, USA, 10001, between Chelsea and Midtown South. It suits families and longer trips wanting kitchen suites, and Trip.com guests rate it 8.7 / 10 Very good 138 reviews, noting a “Nicely updated room” and that “The breakfast offers a good variety”. Honest watch-out: it took a long time for the shower water to get hot.
